text: Read .fcs files using flowCore::read.flowSet(). flowSet S4 class convenient way storing related .fcs files single object. However, S4 object, naturally restricted scope registered methods , thus, foregoes potentially relevant functions EDA, transformation, modelling packages. Turn tibble using flod::to_tibble() function defaults slots flowSet, accepts user specified selection: See ?to_tibble list accepted keywords.
